result.notes: I set other_conditions to null. No document passage says the interest rule is 'complementary' to Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.5. That is also a relationship between laws, not a building, unit or owner condition. The remaining values are supported by the D009 coverage table and the D007 statement that interest applies to fully and partially covered units. No construction cutoff applies, because both pre-1980 and post-June 1980 units are covered. The AB 12 landlord-size condition in D007 belongs to the state deposit cap, not this rule, so landlord_size_condition stays null. owner_occupied_exemption_max_units=2 rests on the Golden Duplex row. That exemption also requires owner occupancy on Dec. 31, 1979, so it is not a general cap on owner-occupied buildings.
